conventions.gamma_source: computed from sediment U/Th/K (NAA at IPEN and analysis at McMaster); 'gamma contribution with 20 cm of sediment homogeneously distributed is 97% of total' cited

samples.provenance: Table 2 (radioisotopes), Table 3 (Dbeta, Dgamma), Table 4 (De, ages); p. 192; thickness from Methods text (USP lab)
samples.notes: Prepared at USP (Ribeirão Preto). Enamel 500 um before and 300 um after HCl 1:10 etch; paper says the etch removed about 100 um from each side. Enamel U below detection (<0.05 ppm; Table 2 also lists <0.01 and K <750 ppm for enamel/dentine 1, column assignment ambiguous). Dose-rate units printed 'mGy/a' but are clearly uGy/a (37 Gy/(305+970) uGy/a = 29.0 ka matches EU age). Dgamma (970) apparently includes cosmic; cosmic stated as 0.934 mGy/a (Prescott & Hutton 1994) which looks inconsistent with Dgamma=970 unless 934 is gamma+cosmic -- recorded as printed.

samples.provenance: Table 2, Table 3, Table 4; p. 192; removal from Methods text (Williams College lab)
samples.notes: Prepared and measured at Williams College (A.R. Skinner): dentine removed mechanically, thickness measured (value not reported), 20 um removed from each side; 137Cs irradiation. Ages also calculated with ROSY. Check: 32/(352+1010) = 23.5 ka vs published EU 24 +- 1.

completeness: partial: enamel U below detection (internal dose ~0), no water content, no k, no 234U/238U, enamel thickness only for tooth 1, dentine thickness not given; sediment measured by two labs and which values entered ROSY is not stated; published Dbeta and Dgamma by uptake model are given
extraction_notes: Two cervid teeth associated with human skeleton 3. Tables 2-4 read twice. Table 2 layout (IPEN vs McMaster columns) was garbled in extraction: sediment values are reliable, enamel/dentine detection limits ambiguous. K in Table 2 given in ppm. Volume/pages 77, 187-195 confirmed from IPEN repository record. The OSL part (Table 7) not transcribed.
benchmark_reason: enamel U below detection; two sediment analyses, the one used is not stated
